plugins.name: Gallery
plugins.description: Disk-backed media gallery and workflow inspector. Scans folders directly, reads captions/.txt sidecars, SD prompts, and ComfyUI workflows from image metadata.

plugins.name: GalleryDL
plugins.description: Background gallery-dl and yt-dlp task management, quick downloads, kiosks, OAuth configuration, and a persistent activity log.

plugins.name: RemBG
plugins.description: High-precision neural background removal, alpha matting, and batch processing powered by BiRefNet & RemBG.

plugins.name: ComfyCaption
plugins.description: Auto-captioning with LLMs/JoyCaption and ComfyUI custom workflow nodes. Captioning GGUF models can be downloaded from HuggingFace via the Caption Models settings page.

plugins.name: AI Renamer
plugins.description: Stage image and video files, preview AI-generated names, then safely apply or undo batch renames.

plugins.name: Beta
plugins.description: Beta channel of the Gallery plugin — the boilerplate for new beta plugins in SDCodex-beta.

plugins.name: Beta Caption
plugins.description: ComfyCaption beta channel: the browser takes two thirds, the last third is a permanent image panel with the picture, its details and the caption editor.
